# Elvis Kahoro's Reflex Starter Template

> A Reflex starter that documents and enforces its conventions so AI agents can extend it correctly on the first try. UI kit: https://github.com/elviskahoro/native

## Start here
- AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: workflow and verification rules
- README.md: layout, deployment, commands

## Conventions
- UI primitives: web/components/ui (native). Agent blocks: web/components/agent.
- Theming: CSS variables in assets/globals.css only.
- Layers: web.web -> web.pages.* -> web.components.* (tach.toml).

## Verify
- uv run pytest -q
- uv run tach check
- uv run tach check-external
- trunk check --all
- rwx run .rwx/pyrefly.yml --wait
- rwx run .rwx/pyright.yml --wait
